caption: The video depicts a close-up of a patterned gray carpet bearing a dark stain near the center, with a black handheld steaming tool on the left and a person's hand gripping a folded blue terry-cloth towel on the right. The tool, fitted with a white side button and a brass nozzle tip, points at the stained area and is not held perfectly still. Over time its nozzle shifts back and forth in short horizontal strokes, alternately closing on and retreating from the stain while the body angle and button position drift slightly across the view. The blue cloth also makes small adjustments, tilting and nudging slightly toward or away from the mark without leaving its position on the right. White steam continuously rises and swirls around the nozzle, the stain, and the cloth, varying in density and partly veiling the surface. The grid pattern and the dark stain remain in view throughout, the stain staying roughly constant in size. The cleaning action is already underway and continues without pause.
